newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - SRW wheat values down, soy up.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - SRW wheat values down, soy up.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf soft red winter wheat basis offers dropped five cents per bushel for April and May positions in reaction to poor export demand, dealers said.
Dealers said SRW wheat values began dropping late Wednesday and the decline continued Thursday.
Hard red winter wheat values were unchanged.
Soybean values rose slightly in reaction to slow barge movement on the Mississippi River because of high water, they said.
Corn basis values were narrowly mixed in light activity.
